expected_failures.why: non_unicode_charset_conversion: wpdb asks the engine for CONVERT(... USING <charset>) on a non-Unicode charset (koi8r, hebrew, cp1251, tis620, ujis, big5); SQLite keeps all text as UTF-8 and has no charset conversion, so the SQLite engine refuses it (Unsupported) and wpdb returns its WP_Error
